description: Source file implementing AVInput plugin for handling HDMI and composite input events, device control, and JSON-RPC methods in a media application.

classes.name: AVInput
classes.description: Main class implementing the AVInput plugin, handling device events, JSON-RPC methods, and device control logic.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets the singleton instance, and calls IARM initialization.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and cleans up resources.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Registers event handlers with IARM bus for HDMI and composite input events.

methods.name: DeinitializeIARM
methods.description: Removes event handlers from IARM bus.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers JSON-RPC methods for device control and information retrieval.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: endpoint_numberOfInputs
methods.description: RPC method to get the number of input ports.

methods.name: endpoint_currentVideoMode
methods.description: RPC method to get the current video mode.

methods.name: endpoint_contentProtected
methods.description: RPC method to indicate content protection status.

methods.name: numberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI input ports.

methods.name: currentVideoMode
methods.description: Returns the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: startInput
methods.description: Starts input on specified port and type, with optional plane and audio settings.

methods.name: stopInput
methods.description: Stops input on specified port and type, resets volume levels.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Sets video rectangle (position and size) for HDMI or composite input.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Internal method to scale video to specified rectangle.

methods.name: getInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves list of input devices for HDMI or composite.

methods.name: writeEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Writes EDID data to a specified port.

methods.name: readEDIDWrapper
methods.description: Reads EDID data from a specified port.

methods.name: getInputDevices
methods.description: Returns list of input device info for HDMI or composite.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Stub for writing EDID data.

methods.name: readEDID
methods.description: Reads EDID data from device, encodes as base64.

methods.name: AVInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug event, notifies device change.

methods.name: AVInputSignalChange
methods.description: Handles signal status change, notifies.

methods.name: AVInputStatusChange
methods.description: Handles input status change, notifies.

methods.name: AVInputVideoModeUpdate
methods.description: Handles video mode update, notifies.

methods.name: dsAviContentTypeEventHandler
methods.description: Handles AVI content type change event.

methods.name: hdmiInputAviContentTypeChange
methods.description: Notifies change in HDMI AVI content type.

methods.name: dsAVEventHandler
methods.description: Handles HDMI and composite hotplug events.

methods.name: dsAVSignalStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Handles signal status change events.

methods.name: dsAVStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Handles device status change events.

methods.name: dsAVVideoModeEventHandler
methods.description: Handles video mode update events.

methods.name: dsAVGameFeatureStatusEventHandler
methods.description: Handles game feature status events.

methods.name: AVInputALLMChange
methods.description: Notifies change in ALLM mode.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves supported game features.

methods.name: getGameFeatureStatusWrapper
methods.description: Gets status of a specific game feature.

methods.name: getALLMStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of ALLM mode for a port.

methods.name: getRawSPDWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves raw SPD info for a port.

methods.name: getSPDWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves SPD info for a port.

methods.name: getRawSPD
methods.description: Gets raw SPD info, encodes as base64.

methods.name: getSPD
methods.description: Gets SPD info, formats as string.

methods.name: setMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets primary and input volume levels.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Sets support for Allm in EDID.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Gets support status for Allm in EDID.

methods.name: setEdidVersionWrapper
methods.description: Sets EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getHdmiVersionWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves HDMI version capability.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Internal method to set EDID version.

methods.name: getEdidVersionWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Internal method to get EDID version.
